provenance.paper: Anderson, J. R., & Lebiere, C. (1998). The Atomic Components of Thought.
provenance.citation: Anderson, J. R., & Lebiere, C. (1998). Lawrence Erlbaum Associates. Chapter 3 (the activation equation A_i = B_i + Σ_j W_j·S_ji) and Chapter 9 (cognitive arithmetic: retrieval of addition facts).
provenance.locus: Ch. 3 Eq. 3.1 activation equation; Ch. 9 addition-fact retrieval 3+4=7 with competing neighbour fact 3+5=8.
provenance.notes: Retrieval of the addition fact 3+4. Chunk fact34 (sum 7) shares two context slots with the goal (addend1=3, addend2=4) and has higher base-level activation; neighbour fact35 shares only addend1=3. A(fact34) = 0.5 + 2/3 ≈ 1.1667 beats A(fact35) = 0.3 + 1/3 ≈ 0.6333.

expected.notes: fact34 wins retrieval by the activation equation; its slots (including sum=7) enter working memory and the output facts.
